This is my first time writing a review on Ulta but felt I really need to for this product. I recently had to ditch my entire skincare routine and am rebuilding it from scratch due to new sensitivities and changing skin care needs in my early 40s. When I went to all sensitive skincare products with zero actives my skin's inflammation, acne, and rosacea cleared up almost immediately, but then my skin seemed to look 5 years older in the course of a month because most of the products for super sensitive skin are very basic and have minimal additives or actives like hyaluronic acid which will add moisture and fill in your fine lines. I then started the slow process of rebuilding a skin-care regimen that would be good for my sensitive skin and target my aesthetic anti-aging wants and needs. Over the course of the last several months I've wasted so so much money on finding good products that make my skin look good without bringing the inflammation and acne back. However, THIS product has been great for both my sensitive skin and my other skincare wants. The hyaluronic acid has nicely hydrated my skin which has filled in all the fine lines that formed. It was like getting thousands of dollars of filler. The niacinamide is shrinking my pores. My face has a nice glowy/hydrated look with no redness. I have been applying it right after I wash my face while my skin is still wet. It just take a couple drops of the serum. I think the bottle will last at least 4 months with how much you need

ANUA PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Capsule 100 Serum It is a usual routine for me to check the package, label and specifically ingredients. I am almost satisfied with this serum however by checking the ingredients, the formula contains: 1-2, Hexanediol (synthetic chemical, a common relative of Propylene Glycol), Propanediol (I mean, the key word is already there "propane), Butylene Glycol that just means butane-1,3-diol (research say, that it is a good humectant). These are the first ingredients mentioned and when it is a first ingredients, it means more percentage and the rest of the ingredients are lower percentage. There's a Sodium DNA/Deoxyribonucleotide a milt from wild salmon and it performs good to our skin as anti-aging, and skin rejuvenating properties. Other ingredients are all plant derived, from their seeds, the parts of the plants by processing them etcetera in which you can just see for yourself and decide by your own. Serum consistency is on watery side, no fragrances and it does absorbs but not as quickly. It is suitable for all skin types and can be use AM and PM. The bottle design is nice, prettt much straightforward. Not sure if I want to purchase this in the future though.

avis.titre: Gives you the glow you want !
avis.texte: If you're like me—someone who's been reviewing skincare and beauty for over four years and constantly on the lookout for formulas that actually deliver—then the Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Capsule 100 Serum needs to be on your radar. This serum feels luxurious from the first pump, and it's packed with a powerful trifecta: PDRN (yes, the same trending ingredient all over K-beauty clinics), hyaluronic acid, and collagen. Together, they work like a hydration magnet and skin-smoother in one. What makes this formula stand out is the use of PDRN, also known as salmon DNA, which visibly improves skin texture and gives that plump, revitalized look over time. I've been using it consistently and have noticed my skin holding onto moisture better throughout the day, even under makeup. This is ideal for anyone with dry, dull, or tired-looking skin who wants to bring back bounce and glow without heavy layering.

I've been using this serum for two weeks now as part of my morning and night routine, and it's quietly become a hydration hero in my lineup. My skin leans dry-combo and I focus a lot on healthy aging, so I was curious how the PDRN, hyaluronic acid, and collagen combo would work for me. The texture is light and smooth, and it absorbs fast without leaving any sticky or greasy feeling. I also love that it's fragrance-free, which is always a win for my sometimes sensitive skin. What I noticed most is how plump and calm my skin looks after using it, especially around my cheeks and jaw. It gives this soft, hydrated glow and makes a great base for the rest of my skincare and makeup. It also layers really well with other products in my routine without pilling. I use a couple drops right after toner, pat it in gently, and follow with my moisturizer. My skin has been feeling balanced and hydrated since adding this in. If your skin needs moisture support or you're building a routine that focuses on barrier care and hydration, this is a solid pick. It's simple, gentle, and effective without any extra fuss. avis.titre: Hydrating Vegan PDRN Serum that Didn't Wow Me
avis.texte: PDRN has been all the rage lately, and I've been a fan of the original formula that are made with salmon DNA. A lot of the Korean skincare brands have been coming out with vegan versions, and I'd like to say that while the vegan ones can mimic some of the effects, they don't deliver the full regenerative effects the way the salmon DNA does. That said, vegan PDRN can be a great entry point for beginners or those with sensitive skin. The Anua PDRN Hyaluronic Acid Capsule 100 Serum didn't impress me much, and I found the texture rather too watery. This means you need to work in the product quickly as it can easily run down from the face. 💧 I personally disliked how runny this was. I get it, it's supposed to help with easy absorption into the skin, but you need an amazing amount of control to make sure this doesn't fall off your face while applying it. You also need to rub it in pretty quickly. To me, it just looks a setup for wasted product. 💧 This is made with sodium PDRN, not actual salmon DNA. It's a vegan version meant to mimic the real thing. I've tried other vegan PDRN formulations before and found some to be quite effective, but this one was kind of a letdown for me. The only noticeable improvement was a slight boost in hydration, nothing beyond that. 💧 I've known the brand since before the packaging change.
